summary: Tested continuous alarm loop feature for Admin Orders tab (both backend and frontend). Backend: POST /api/orders with fulfillment_type=takeaway creates orders successfully; Pushover emergency call (priority=2, retry=30, expire=360) executes without exception; admin listing/status APIs behave correctly. Frontend: Admin login redirects to /Angel/dashboard; on Orders tab, when a NEW order arrives on next 8s poll, the alarm-banner appears with pulse animation and 'Stop alarm' (data-testid stop-alarm) button; clicking stop-alarm removes banner immediately; after confirming all 'new' orders via advance-*, banner auto-dismisses on the next poll (~1-8s). Menu tab bulk multi-select correctly exposes bulk-tag-select, bulk-delete-selected, and bulk-actions-bar.

minor.issue: Backend Pushover call is synchronous (uses `requests` inside async handler) with 10s timeout — could block the event loop on slow network. Consider running via asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient.

issues: Missing product images produce 404s in console for at least 2 products (broken image_url paths).

action_items: (Optional) make Pushover POST non-blocking (asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient) to avoid blocking event loop.
Fix broken product image_urls surfaced as 404 on Menu tab.
critical_code_review_comments: OrdersTab uses `alarmTimerRef.current` only for setInterval id; the guard `if (alarmTimerRef.current) return` in startAlarm correctly prevents duplicate intervals, but the initial `ping.play()` fires only once at start — for the first 30s window there is only a single beep. Acceptable per spec (every 30s repeat).
startAlarm relies on `lastIdsRef.current.size` being empty to auto-stop; when a poll sets it to 0 the alarm is stopped inside `load()` — good.

ping.play() requires user gesture to enable AudioContext; the 'Activer le son' button (enable-sound) must be clicked before browsers will emit sound. UI test verified the visual banner but audio activation is not verified in headless browsers.
server.py create_order uses blocking `requests.post` for Pushover inside async endpoint — small perf concern.
Admin.jsx file is 1779 lines; consider splitting per-tab into separate files.
seed_data_creation: Tests created a handful of TEST_ / UI-prefixed orders in restaurant menu (product 'Test' at 9.99). Not cleaned up (no delete-order endpoint used) — orders visible in admin listing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alarm feature works end-to-end. Test flow: login as owner -> Orders tab -> wait ~3s for baseline poll -> POST /api/orders (same-origin via page.evaluate fetch to bypass any 403) -> banner appears within 8-15s -> click data-testid=stop-alarm to remove OR click all data-testid=advance-<id> that read 'Confirmer la commande' to auto-dismiss on next poll.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the tested feature.
